title: Qualcomm Workshop: Intro to Edge AI
description: Enter into the world of Edge AI in this beginner-friendly, hands-on workshop! Learn how low-power, on-device AI can solve real-world problems without relying on the cloud. Collect data, train and test a machine learning model, and see how the same model can run on a tiny device. No coding experience required. All you need is curiosity, a willingness to experiment, and a laptop to follow along!

participants.title: Computer Engineering Student @ University of Toronto; Software Engineer Intern @ Qualcomm
